units.source_text: 七月末，我的眷属也迁到轻井泽来了。

en.t: At the end of July, my family also moved to Karuizawa.

units.source_text: 为了这盘棋，我往返于箱根和轻井泽之间，

en.t: For this match, I traveled back and forth between Hakone and Karuizawa,

units.source_text: 单程就得花七个小时，在对局前一天必须离开山中小屋。

en.t: and the trip took seven hours each way, so I had to leave the mountain cottage the day before a game.

units.source_text: 中途暂停多在傍晚，归途要么在箱根，要么在东京歇一宿，前后得花三天时间。

en.t: The adjournment usually came in the evening, and on the way back I would spend a night either in Hakone or in Tokyo, so the whole trip took three days.

units.source_text: 每隔五天一对局，回家也只能待两天就要往回跑，每天还得写观战记。

en.t: A game was played every five days, and even when I returned home I could stay only two days before hurrying back, while I still had to write my game reports every day.

units.source_text: 这是一个令人讨厌的多雨的夏天，加上我过于疲倦，

en.t: It was an unpleasant, rainy summer, and on top of that I was overly tired,

units.source_text: 虽然在对局的旅馆住后觉得好些，可是中途暂停后，

en.t: and although I felt somewhat better after staying at the inn where the match was held, after an adjournment

units.source_text: 我草草吃罢晚饭，忙着回家去。

en.t: I would finish dinner hastily and hurry home.
